data.title: Shibuya: make canyon walls read as distinct buildings

data.body: Follow-up to FA-29. User: 'more realistic. lets make it look more like buildings'. After FA-29 each canyon wall is still ONE continuous plane — a single asphalt-colored facade with a uniform window/floor grid and signage stacks floating on it. Real Shibuya walls are rows of DISTINCT narrow buildings: separate masses with different heights and rooflines, different facade tones/materials, per-building window rhythms and widths, hard vertical seams between neighbors, buildings' own storefront bases. Goal: restructure the wall paint/markup so each wall reads as 4-6 individual buildings butted together, signage stacks belonging to specific buildings, roofline stepping against the night. Constraints: stays scenery (aria-hidden), inside BRANDING.md (grounds palette §2, canyon geometry §7 — walls remain the two rotated planes under one perspective, static, no new animations), build contract in root CLAUDE.md, node build.js + commit rebuilt index.html.

Impl complete at 3c96cff. Wrapped wallstacks in 14 .bldg divs (7 models a-g as custom-prop bundles: bh/bw/facade-veil tones from ground tokens, per-model vh window pitches, film-2 fascia + hue spill, --drop offsets); deleted .wall-windows + uniform wall paint; bands align flex-end with 3px night seams, right-wall bands row-reverse; parapet ::before, one bulkhead per wall (bldg-c); far models 90/94/98% with far-bottom scale origin so the terminus stays walled. Verified: node build.js clean, only 5 pre-existing shibuya-* keyframes, no pseudo-class commas, script.js and .street layer zero-diff; headless Chrome screenshots at 1440x900 / 375x812 / 320x568 / 568x320 show distinct stepped buildings on both walls, scrollWidth==viewport at all widths (320==320), built root page renders shibuya at its 1400 bucket.

REVIEW (commit 3c96cff, cold read of diff + plan). Verified: (1) build reproducible — node build.js produces zero diff against committed root index.html; (2) shibuya/script.js untouched and the .street readable layer byte-identical in the commit; (3) zero new ids/keyframes/animations — all additions are static paint, reduced-motion safe; at-rules unchanged (5 shibuya-* keyframes + 2 media, all pre-existing); no commas in functional pseudo-classes; no literal </style>; (4) palette clean — new rules use only rgb() forms of ground/night veils, film whites, and the seven neon hues; facades are var(--asphalt)/var(--board) under night/film veils; the warm window-speck rgb(255 200 140)/(255 210 160) values are FA-29 pre-existing, migrated verbatim from the deleted .wall-windows; (5) geometry intact — .canyon keeps overflow:clip + single perspective 900px at 50%/50%, walls remain the two rotated direct children, no filter on .canyon, depth filters exactly on the two .wall-bands, no per-building filters, no preserve-3d/translateZ/fixed; (6) hue adjacency hand-checked — every stack sequence has no consecutive same hue, the two double-stack far joins differ (konbini->kusuri left, konbini->nama right), and across every mid seam the stacks cycle the neons at offsets differing by 2 or 4 mod 6 with drops far smaller than a sign height, so no same-hue horizontal contact (screenshots concur, row-reverse on right-wall bands accounted for); (7) rendered in Chrome via Playwright at 1440x900, 375x812, 320x568 standalone + built root at 1450: walls read as distinct stepped slabs with night above rooflines, hard 3px seams, visibly different facade tones and window rhythms (dense grid / ribbon / near-blank confirmed in a brightened inspection render), one stair bulkhead per wall, storefront spills warm-left/cool-right, terminus stays in haze with far rooflines above the haze top (no open night gap), hero forrest almasi on near-dark backdrop, scrollWidth==320 at 320px, mobile shows a sane 2-buildings-per-wall reduced scene. Minor note, not blocking: right mid band widths sum to 95% leaving a small far-end alley gap — reads as intentional asymmetry. Meets all plan acceptance criteria. PASS — no fixes needed.
